title: AI Resume Builder
description: This web app allows users to create multiple resumes, picking and chosing various experiences and projects, with AI enhancement to make sure bullet points are optimzed with proper structure and keywords.

title: RecipeApp
description: A cross-platform mobile application built with .NET MAUI that allows users to efficiently manage their recipes. The app features intuitive navigation for adding, editing, and organizing recipes with detailed ingredients, instructions, and images. Users can categorize recipes, filter by cuisine or dietary preferences, and generate shopping lists. The app also includes a favorites section for quick access to preferred dishes and supports cloud synchronization to ensure recipes are accessible across devices.
